questions.question: What is the course code of the Deep Learning lab manual?
Which college publishes this lab manual, and which year, semester and academic year is it for?
questions.ground_truth: Malla Reddy College of Engineering & Technology; B.Tech IV Year, I Semester, academic year 2024-25.

questions.question: How many programs are listed in the lab index?
questions.ground_truth: 16 programs (S.No. 1 to 16, matching Week-1 to Week-16).
evidence: Implement Auto encoders for image denoising

questions.question: What CPU and how much RAM do the lab systems have?
questions.ground_truth: Intel Core i3-3240 CPU at 3.40 GHz with 4 GB RAM.

questions.question: How are the 15 marks for day-to-day evaluation distributed?
questions.ground_truth: 3 marks each for Regularity, Program written, Execution & Result, Viva-Voce and Dress Code.

questions.question: How are the 30 internal lab marks distributed?
questions.ground_truth: Average of day-to-day evaluation: 15 marks; lab mid exam: 10 marks; viva and observation: 5 marks.

questions.question: How are the 70 external lab marks distributed?
questions.ground_truth: Program written 30, program execution and result 20, viva-voce 10, record 10.

questions.question: What happens if the lab record is not submitted on time or is not written properly?
questions.ground_truth: The evaluation marks (5M) will be deducted.

questions.question: How early should students arrive at the lab?
questions.ground_truth: At least 5 minutes before the starting time; students who come after 5 minutes are not allowed in.

questions.question: Which sklearn class does Week-1 (a) use for the single-unit perceptron, and which data file does it read?
questions.ground_truth: Perceptron() from sklearn.linear_model, reading placement.csv.

questions.question: Which logic functions are classified with the perceptron in Week-1 (b), and which two are left for the exercise?
questions.ground_truth: OR, AND and XOR data are classified in the program; the exercise asks for NOT and XNOR data.

questions.question: Which dataset and test split does the Week-2 backpropagation ANN use?
questions.ground_truth: The Iris dataset with test_size=0.40.

questions.question: What is the minimum number of hidden layers required in the Week-3 deep feed forward ANN?
questions.ground_truth: At least 4 hidden layers (>=4).

questions.question: What hidden layer sizes and output layer does the Week-4 MNIST deep feed forward network use?
questions.ground_truth: Three hidden layers with 128, 64 and 32 neurons (ReLU activation), and a 10-unit softmax output layer.

questions.question: How many convolution layers and filters does the Week-5 CNN use, and for how many epochs is it trained?
questions.ground_truth: Two Conv2D layers with 64 filters each (3x3 kernel), each followed by ReLU and 2x2 max pooling; trained for 10 epochs with batch size 64.

questions.question: What must be recorded when running the Week-6 CNN program on Fashion MNIST?
questions.ground_truth: The accuracy for the number of epochs, and the time required to run the program on CPU as well as on GPU in Colab.
evidence: CPU as well as using GPU

questions.question: Which epoch values are required in the Week-7 exercise on padding and Batch Normalization?
questions.ground_truth: 5, 25 and 225 epochs.

questions.question: Which five architectures are compared in Week-8, and what L1 regularization strength does the program use?
questions.ground_truth: Base model; model with L1 regularization; model with L2 regularization; model with Dropout; model with both L2 (or L1) and Dropout. The L1 program uses kernel_regularizer=l1(0.01).

questions.question: Which Keras class does Week-9 use to create new images from a single image, and what shift setting does it use?
questions.ground_truth: ImageDataGenerator with width_shift_range=[-100,100]; it generates 9 augmented samples.

questions.question: Which optimizer and learning rate does the Week-10 CIFAR-10 program use?
questions.ground_truth: RMSprop (tf.keras.optimizers.legacy.RMSprop) with learning rate 0.0005 and decay 1e-6.

questions.question: Which activation function and layer sizes does the LeNet-5 program in Week-11 use?
questions.ground_truth: tanh activation; Conv2D layers with 6, 16 and 120 filters (kernel size 5) with average pooling, then Dense 84 (tanh) and a 10-unit softmax output.

questions.question: What input image size and final layers does the Week-12 VGG16 program use?
questions.ground_truth: Input size 224x224x3; two Dense(4096, relu) layers followed by Dense(2, softmax) for cat vs dog.

questions.question: Which callbacks does the Week-12 VGG16 program use?
questions.ground_truth: ModelCheckpoint (saving vgg16_1.h5, best model only) and EarlyStopping (patience=20).

questions.question: What is the size of the noise vector for the Week-15 GAN generator, and what activation does the generator's last layer use?
questions.ground_truth: The noise vector has size 100; the last layer (Conv2DTranspose) uses tanh and outputs a 28x28x1 image.

questions.question: What noise factor is used to create the noisy images in the Week-16 denoising autoencoder?
questions.ground_truth: factor = 0.39 (Gaussian noise is added to the images, then clipped to the range 0 to 1).

questions.question: What test accuracy did the Week-5 MNIST CNN achieve?
questions.ground_truth: I don't know.
questions.note: Trap: the manual only prints 'Test accuracy' in code. Every OUTPUT section is blank, so no accuracy value exists.

questions.question: What is the name of the Head of the Department who signs this lab manual?
questions.ground_truth: I don't know.
questions.note: The manual only has the titles 'Head of the Department' and 'Principal' with no names.

questions.question: Which GPU model does Google Colab assign for the Week-6 timing experiment?
questions.ground_truth: I don't know.
questions.note: The manual says to record CPU and GPU time in Colab but never names a GPU model.

questions.question: Which BERT or transformer model does the manual use for sentiment analysis?
questions.ground_truth: I don't know.
questions.note: The manual uses SimpleRNN and Bidirectional LSTM only; it never mentions BERT or transformers.

questions.question: Who won the 2018 FIFA World Cup?
questions.ground_truth: I don't know.
